StepDescription: Launch Lorenzo Application
Login with valid credentials
Wait for home page to load
-- REGISTER NEW PATIENT --
Click Patients tab to navigate to Patients section
Wait for Patients section to expand
Click Register new patient task pane link
Wait for patient search page to load
Enter patient surname to search for existing record
Click Find button to search patient records
Handle no records found dialog and click Registration
Wait for patient registration form to load
Enter patient forename in registration form
Generate and enter random surname for the patient
Click postal code lookup to search for address
Enter postcode in postal code search field
Click Find button to retrieve address by postcode
Select address row from postcode search results
Enter city in address field
Select country from dropdown list
Enter home telephone number
Enter mobile telephone number
Enter email address
Click Next to proceed to additional demographics page
Wait for additional demographics page to load
Select communication preference type
Select country of birth
Select nationality
Select religion
Select sexual orientation
Select ethnicity
Click Finish to complete patient registration
Wait for registration confirmation popup
Capture NHS Number from registration confirmation popup
Verify NHS Number has been successfully generated
Click OK to dismiss registration confirmation popup
-- FIND RECORD AND OPEN EPR VIEW --
Wait for home page to return
Click Find record task pane link to search for registered patient
Wait for patient identifier search to load
Enter captured NHS Number to find patient record
Click Find button to locate patient record
Wait for patient search results grid to load
Click patient surname link to open the patient record
Wait for EPR View to load
Verify EPR View has loaded successfully with patient PAS ID
-- NAVIGATE TO MEDICATION EPR AND OPEN MEDICATION CLERKING --
Click Medication EPR tab to navigate to medication section
Wait for Medication EPR tab to load
Click Medication Clerking link to initiate medication review
Wait for medication review popup to appear
Dismiss the medication review information popup by clicking OK
Wait for medication clerking source selection popup
Select Patient as medication clerking source
Click OK to confirm clerking source selection
Wait for Medication Clerking form viewer to load
-- PRESCRIBE MED1 (paracetamol) --
Click Search to open medication search panel for Med1
Enter Med1 drug name in medication search field
Click Search drug catalogue to find Med1
Select Med1 (paracetamol) from the drug catalogue results
Click Select Item to add Med1 to the prescription
Click green copy icon to copy Med1 across to prescribing form
Select route of administration for Med1
Select dosage form for Med1
Select dose type for Med1
Set dose amount for Med1
Select unit of measure for Med1 dose
Select frequency for Med1 administration
Click OK to save Med1 prescription details
Wait for prescribing form to refresh after Med1 entry
-- PRESCRIBE MED2 (senna) --
Enter Med2 drug name in medication search field
Click Search drug catalogue to find Med2
Select Med2 (senna) from the drug catalogue results
Click Select Item to add Med2 to the prescription
Click green copy icon to copy Med2 across to prescribing form
Select route of administration for Med2
Select dosage form for Med2
Select dose type for Med2
Set dose amount for Med2
Select unit of measure for Med2 dose
Select frequency for Med2 administration
Click OK to save Med2 prescription details
Wait for prescribing form to refresh after Med2 entry
-- PRESCRIBE MED3 (flucloxacillin) --
Enter Med3 drug name in medication search field
Click Search drug catalogue to find Med3
Select Med3 (flucloxacillin) from drug catalogue results
Click Select Item to add Med3 to the prescription
Click green copy icon to copy Med3 across to prescribing form
Verify Med3 medication row is present in the prescribing form
Select route of administration for Med3
Select dosage form for Med3
Select dose type for Med3
Enter dose amount for Med3
Select unit of measure for Med3 dose
Select frequency for Med3 administration
Click OK to save Med3 prescription details
Wait for prescribing form to refresh after Med3 entry
-- COPY MED1 AND MED2 TO INPATIENT MEDICATION LIST --
Click green copy icon to copy Med1 (paracetamol) to IP medication list
Set first administration time slot for Med1
Set second administration time slot for Med1
Click OK to confirm Med1 copy to IP medication list
Wait for IP medication list to update after Med1 copy
Click green copy icon to copy Med2 (senna) to IP medication list
Set first administration time slot for Med2
Set second administration time slot for Med2
Click OK to confirm Med2 copy to IP medication list
Wait for conflict popup to appear after Med2 copy
Dismiss medication conflict popup by clicking OK
Select reason for conflict resolution
Click OK to confirm conflict resolution reason
Wait for IP medication list to update after Med2 conflict resolution
-- MODIFY MED3 DETAILS AND ADD TO INPATIENT MEDICATION LIST --
Click green copy icon to copy Med3 (flucloxacillin) to IP list for modification
Select modified dose type for Med3 on IP list
Enter modified dose range minimum value for Med3
Enter modified dose range maximum value for Med3
Set administration time slot for Med3 on IP list
Select modification clerking reason for Med3 change
Click OK to apply Med3 modifications to IP list
Wait for medication conflict popup after Med3 modification
Dismiss medication conflict popup for Med3
Select dose range check response for Med3
Click OK to confirm dose range check for Med3
Wait for IP medication list to update after Med3 modification
Verify Med3 (flucloxacillin) is present with updated details on IP medication list
-- PRESCRIBE MED4 (sodium chloride 0.9%) TO INPATIENT LIST --
Enter Med4 drug name in medication search field
Click Search drug catalogue to find Med4
Select Med4 (sodium chloride 0.9% infusion) from drug catalogue results
Click Select Item to add Med4 to the prescription
Click green copy icon to copy Med4 to IP medication list
Select route of administration for Med4 infusion
Select infusion dosage form for Med4
Select dose type for Med4
Enter dose amount for Med4 infusion
Select unit of measure for Med4 dose
Select frequency for Med4 administration
Click OK to save Med4 prescription details
Set first administration time slot for Med4
Set second administration time slot for Med4
Dismiss dose check popup for Med4
Select dose range check response for Med4
Click OK to confirm dose range check for Med4
Wait for IP medication list to update after Med4 addition
-- SAVE MEDICATION CLERKING AND VALIDATE DATA --
Click Finish to complete the medication clerking form
Wait for print document page to load
Click Finish on print document page to save medication record
Wait for medication EPR view to reload
-- NAVIGATE TO INPATIENT MEDICATIONS AND VALIDATE --
Click Inpatient tab to navigate to inpatient medications section
Wait for inpatient medications list to load
Verify Med1 (paracetamol) is listed in inpatient medications
Verify Med2 (senna) is listed in inpatient medications
Verify Med3 (flucloxacillin) updated details are accurately reflected
Verify Med4 (sodium chloride) is listed in inpatient medications
-- MEDICATION ADMINISTRATION -- ACCESS AND VERIFY MEDICATIONS DUE --
Click Medication Administration link to open administration chart
Wait for Medication Administration Chart to load
Verify Medications Due list is displayed in administration chart
-- RECORD ADMINISTRATION AND VALIDATE ENTRY --
Enter administered dose amount in Record Administration form
Select Given radio button as administration route status
Click OK to confirm and save the administration record
Wait for Medication Administration Chart to refresh
Verify drug administered icon appears confirming entry in Medication Administration Chart
-- NAVIGATE TO OVERVIEW TAB AND VALIDATE PRESCRIPTION AND ADMIN HISTORY --
Click Overview tab to navigate to prescription and administration history
Wait for Overview tab to load
Validate drug administered icon is present in the Overview tab history
-- OPEN PRESCRIPTION CHART AND OMIT DOSAGE SLOT --
Click Prescription Chart link to open the prescription chart view
Wait for Prescription Chart to load
Select a dosage slot tablet icon to target for omission
Click Omit to initiate slot omission
Select the Omit radio button to confirm omission type
Enter comments for the omission
Click OK to confirm slot omission
Click Finish to save the omission changes in prescription chart
Wait for prescription chart to refresh after omission
Validate omit icon is displayed confirming slot omission status
-- SELECT REINSTATE DOSE AND VERIFY SLOT RETURNS TO PREVIOUS STATE --
Click omitted slot icon to select it for reinstatement
Click Reinstate to restore the omitted dose slot
Enter reinstatement reason in the text field
Click OK to confirm dose reinstatement
Click Finish to save reinstatement in prescription chart
Wait for prescription chart to refresh after reinstatement
Verify tablet icon is restored confirming slot returned to previous state
-- CLEAR SELECTION AND RETURN TO MEDICATION EPR DASHBOARD --
Click Clear Selection to deselect all slots in prescription chart
Wait for prescription chart view to update after clear selection
Click Finish to return to Medication EPR dashboard
-- FINAL VALIDATION OF ALL CURRENT MEDICATION RECORDS --
Wait for Medication EPR dashboard to reload
Final validation: Verify Med1 (paracetamol) is present in current medication records
Final validation: Verify Med2 (senna) is present in current medication records
Final validation: Verify Med3 (flucloxacillin) is present in current medication records
Final validation: Verify Med4 (sodium chloride 0.9%) is present in current medication records
-- LOGOUT --
Click Logout button to exit Lorenzo application
Confirm logout by clicking Yes on confirmation dialog
